dossier.headline: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO priced at ₹129–136
dossier.summary: Coal India is selling about 10% of Mahanadi Coalfields through a pure offer for sale of 66.18 crore shares, with all proceeds going to the parent. The price band of ₹129–136 makes it an ₹8,981 crore issue that values the company at about ₹90,000 crore at the top end. It runs November 19–23, a day after Crystal Crop's IPO opens.
why_it_matters: It is one of the largest issues in the 2026 IPO pipeline
watch: The grey-market premium, cited at about 7–10%
questions: How will institutional demand shape the subscription?
What does the valuation imply for Coal India's own stake value?
conflicts: Pre-band size estimates were about ₹9,500 crore in one report and about ₹10,000 crore in another; the band puts it at ₹8,981 crore
